plan_authority: Codex-native orchestration is the sole execution authority. Taskplane governs contracts, classifies dependencies and scopes, emits deterministic intents, prepares worktrees and checkpoints, and observes evidence only; delivery uses direct Codex assignments. Taskplane owns no scheduler, capacity model, reservation, admission queue, replay queue, lease-concurrency, worker-lifecycle, or execution-DAG authority. delivery_mode=build; automatic_lenses=[]

criteria: AC1: Before Plan authorization, Design contains the complete evidenced Codex-native capability inventory and responsibility map; the Design and architecture gate refuse Taskplane-owned scheduling, capacity, reservation, admission, replay, lease-concurrency, worker-lifecycle, or execution-DAG authority, and removing a native mapping or introducing duplicate authority makes both static and behavioral seam proofs fail and blocks Design or Plan before Build.

AC4: At every governed stage, each ready pairwise-disjoint task or criterion appears exactly once in one deterministic native Codex dispatch set, overlaps are held only for recorded dependency or ownership, and one event-driven wait wakes on completion or attention; severed readiness, dispatch, completion, or wait wiring fails closed without replacement Taskplane scheduling state.

AC7: On the final clean candidate, atomic reconciliation proves Git HEAD, governed progress, run journal, tasks and gates, public report, repository verification report, release evidence, and exports terminal evidence all name the identical full SHA, terminal status, requirement, and evidence fingerprints; every named selector, receipt, and producer edge is validated and executed in the actual pinned and final candidate checkout, generated temporary substitutes are prohibited, opaque or foreign wiring fingerprints cannot authorize terminal or release truth, and severing any named edge makes the exact production test fail; finalization publishes all terminal projections for the exact SHA or none, and stale, executing, missing, mixed, contradictory, severed-edge, or partial truth blocks Done, merge, push, and release claims, while retry converges without overwriting immutable evidence and no retained run remains executing after delivery reaches main.
